verdict.rationale: Unity's Package Manager and Asset Database docs (unity-docs-13, unity-docs-12/29) show a formal system for pulling in third-party packages/assets, and independent community evidence (unity-comm-6) confirms the real-world existence of the Unity Asset Store with hundreds of third-party assets in active use. Editor extensibility docs (unity-docs-10/30) further support a plugin ecosystem for tools built on top of Unity. missing for 10: no first-party doc directly describing the Asset Store's scale/catalog size, and no independent review quantifying ecosystem breadth beyond the LGPL-store anecdote.
